title: Chapter 84 Chicken Blood
content:
Chapter 84 Chicken Blood

"Heifu Pavilion Chief, where are the pavilion soldiers? Why haven't they come back yet?"

On the other side, at Li Zheng's home, Li Zheng "Feng" in Blind Mountain stood up and looked outside as if he was worried.

"Perhaps they have gone too far. Don't worry about them. Li Zheng, you and I can continue talking."

Heifu smiled on the surface, but he never stopped thinking in his heart.

His strategy is actually very simple. He wants to detain the local officials who may be protecting the local folks and the local residents who come to see the excitement, so that they can relax their guard. Ji Ying and Li Xian took the opportunity to walk around to see if the suspicious house was the person they were looking for...

As a graduate of the police academy in his previous life, he had learned more or less about trafficking cases. There was even a senior police officer who taught them a lesson about his ten years of experience in trafficking...

In class, what the senior said was very serious, about the harm of trafficking to society, the effectiveness of the country's anti-trafficking and so on...

But after class, when he sat with them to eat, the old man started to reveal his true feelings after a few sips of wine.

Seniors said that in such trafficking incidents in mountainous rural areas, the whole village is often involved. In a place as big as a palm, no matter how high you look up or when you look down, who doesn’t know what’s going on in someone’s house? And often when one family buys it, the neighbors will also buy it, and they will commit crimes in their dens, pulling out radishes and bringing out the mud.

Even the village cadres will help cover up, because if they don't help, the village official will be the end of his job. That's why there were several cases of abductions, because the police car was alerted, and as soon as the police car entered the village, the whole village was dispatched to block them and prevent them from passing.

The villagers have an invisible collective consciousness, especially in this regard, everyone is very united. Because if you don't help others hold on to their wives today, tomorrow you will have nothing if your own wives run away. In the village, buying a daughter-in-law costs at least a few thousand to tens of thousands, which is basically all the savings of a family, and you can only afford one in a lifetime.

In fact, in a place like that, if you buy a cow, you can probably afford one for a lifetime, right?

The gap between humans and animals is sometimes so small.

What should I do at this time, shoot? The senior smiled and said, it was impossible, that would cause violence, and no one would be able to eat and walk around. In the end, I can only leave in despair as if I have lost a battle, hoping to come back next time when I am fully prepared, but when I come back, I can no longer find him...

This was still the case in the 1980s and 1990s in later generations, let alone the Qin Dynasty more than two thousand years ago?

Heifu didn't trust the officials in Blind Mountain at all. Asking them about robbery and selling was tantamount to seeking the skin of a tiger.

He could only pretend to be a mediocre and incompetent pavilion chief, as if he wanted to collude with the local officials. Anyway, there was no information here, and no one from the local officials to the local people knew his name or deeds.

The plan originally went smoothly, but now, the residents who came to see the excitement have dispersed one after another, but there is no news from Li Xian Ji Ying and others. The longer time goes by, the more suspicious Li Zheng becomes, and Heifu's trick of "drag" will no longer work.

Just at this time, the silly younger brother in his twenties from the Li Zheng family ran out and yelled at them, breaking the awkward atmosphere of having nothing to say. Li Zheng frowned and asked someone to take him away, and then sighed and said that his younger brother fell on his head when he was a child, and it has always been like this.

Then, the chicken was finally killed...

A cook who looked like an aunt came to the main hall with a pottery pot. In front of everyone, he poured a little rice wine into it, added some wild peppercorns, salt and sauce, and quickly mixed it dozens of times with a wooden stick. , then poured the hot contents into the pottery bowl...

The color was very bright, it was bright red and hot chicken blood, with a little wild peppercorns and blood foam floating on it. When he put it in front of Hei Fu, a strong fishy smell hit his face.

"Chief Heifu Pavilion, please use it!"

Rimasa and Tiandian introduced that raw chicken blood is a delicacy here, which can activate blood circulation and replenish deficiency. As they spoke, they drank a bowl of raw chicken blood in a demonstration and burped. It looked like Very satisfied.

Dongmen Leopard also tried to take a sip, frowned, and finally finished the drink.

Now it was Heifu's turn to have some pain in his balls, raw chicken blood, this should be a recipe passed down from the Pu and Yue people in the Jianghan area. Nowadays, most of the people living in the remote areas of Nan County are descendants of these two ethnic groups, but their language has only become Chu-formed.

Although it is polite to eat some of the food served by the host, Heifu really doesn’t want to drink it...

He was afraid of parasites, and if he got one, it would be no joke.

So Heifu raised the pottery bowl and was about to drink it, but suddenly he held his stomach and cried out in pain, saying that he had to go to the toilet.

After Heifu left in a hurry, Satomasa and Tian Dian couldn't help but have some contempt in their eyes. They also said with a smile: "Isn't Mr. Heifu afraid of this bowl of raw chicken blood..."

The Dongmen Leopard on the side was furious when he heard this. As soon as he wiped the blood from his mouth, he wanted to go over and teach these two people a lesson, letting them know that Huyang Pavilion is where the most vicious and evil people in Anlu County gather!

But thinking of Heifu's instructions to him, Qiuting managed to hold back.

As a result, Satsumasa and Tian Dian despised Kuro Fu even more...

What should they think if they knew that the person they were leading through the door was a tiger instead of a local dog?

…

"Why can't you go to Huxuan over there?"

In the courtyard of Li Zheng's house, Heifu was stopped by Li Zheng's nephew on his way to Muxuan. He refused to let him go there, but led him to a corner and asked him to make do with it here.

Heifu remained calm, unbuckling his belt and talking to this simple young man.

"No one is allowed to go there. Could it be because there are concubines in the house? Are those concubines bought from outside? By the way, does Li Zheng's younger brother have a wife?"

Nephew Li Zheng nodded dullly, but then shook his head quickly. When Hei Fu asked him again, he refused to say a word.

Heifu felt bored and began to think about what to do next.

Of course, the bowl of chicken blood was a trivial matter. What he was worried about was what if Ji Ying, Li Xian and the others failed and found nothing.

At this moment, a whistle sound of "咻" suddenly came from the distance!

Heifu quickly raised his head, and then heard the second and third sounds!

call out! call out! The whistle is whining rapidly!

Three sharp whistles came from Libei, passing through a distance of more than a hundred steps and reaching the sky above Lizheng's house, making people nearby confused.

Only Hei Fu's expression suddenly became heavy.

He once asked his sister-in-law in the county to help build several small copper whistles. Brass was used as the raw material and high-quality cork was used as the whistle core. They could blow a very sharp sound that could be heard clearly from a hundred steps away! This thing has now become the standard equipment of Huyangting policemen. In this era where communication basically relies on shouting, the copper whistle can undoubtedly come in handy.

Before Heifu entered Blind Mountain, he left a copper whistle to Xiao Tao, another to Li Xian, and another to himself.

He and Li Xian agreed that the two parties would use a copper whistle as a means of communication and would only blow it when in danger.

A sound means that the person has not been found, but there is danger.

The Ersheng representative was found, but was in danger.

And three beeps... meant that the situation was extremely complicated and they were in danger! Need immediate rescue!

"Something must have happened!"

Heifu immediately put on his belt and quickly returned to the hall.

Satomasa and Tiandian were in the house and did not hear the whistle outside. At this moment, they looked down on Heifu and did not get up. They just sat there and smiled and said: "The pavilion chief came just in time, the chicken blood is still warm..."

As soon as he finished speaking, a loud shout suddenly came from outside!

"Help!"

…

It’s a woman’s shrill voice!

Heifu turned around and saw that in the yard, in the direction where he had been stopped just now, a woman was knocking away the stupid Li Zheng's younger brother, running towards this side like crazy, but was stopped by two people. He hugged her hard and tried to cover her mouth...

But the woman bit the hand covering her mouth severely, and took the time to shout in the direction of Hei Fu: "Help, I was robbed and sold, my name is Yuan..."

Before she could finish her words, she was slapped so hard that she fainted, and was forcibly dragged away by the two upright family members - she was probably working in the backyard just now, riding the whistle. He only found an opportunity to run out after attracting the attention of others.

"Kite..." Heifu chewed on the name and suddenly realized.

It turns out that they have been looking for donkeys on donkeys!

At this time, the bearded Li Zheng stood up with an embarrassed look on his face and kept explaining: "Master, please don't listen to her nonsense. She is my brother's wife. There is no other way. No one is willing to marry him, so I can only Find a crazy concubine to make do with it. Come on, let's continue talking, the chicken blood needs to be drunk while it's hot, and the chicken is almost cooked..."

"Yes, yes, there are crazy women everywhere. I didn't hear anything just now!"

Hei Fu also laughed, but thought coldly in his heart, this guy is really capable. He is upright, knows the law and breaks the law, and takes the lead in buying women who have been robbed and sold to be the wife of his stupid brother...

As if he didn't take it seriously, he picked up the bowl of chicken blood and walked towards it. He also said that he would treat this as wine and treat the host hospitably.

Li Zheng didn't know what Hei Fu was thinking. He had no doubt that he was there, but when Hei Fu raised the bowl in front of him, he stopped laughing and took action suddenly!

A bowl of chicken blood hit Li Zheng on the head!

The pottery bowl made a crisp sound and broke into several pieces. The bright red blood splashed everywhere, with peppercorns and blood foam. It was sticky and covered with the straight hair and thick beard. It was impossible to tell whether it was a chicken. Blood, or honest blood...

Heifu was really angry and cursed: "Crazy women can be found everywhere, but thanks to you, there are especially many in Blind Mountain!"

Li Zheng was stunned. Heifu grabbed his arm and threw him over his shoulder. He threw him hard on the table and smashed the table into pieces. Then he twisted his arm with his backhand. Li Zheng said this Only then did he scream in pain!

Everyone was stunned by this sudden change, but Heifu raised his head and shouted to Dongmen Bao: "Ah Bao, do it!"

"promise!"

Dongmen Leopard just heard Masada Nori and the two laughing at Hei Fu's timidity, saying that the pavilion chief didn't even dare to drink chicken blood and had been patient for a long time. At this moment, Yi Gulu stood up, like an agile leopard, and pounced towards Tian Dian, who was still in a daze! Push him to the ground!

Li Zheng's family members heard the sound and rushed forward with kitchen knives and wooden sticks. They saw that the hall was in a mess, and chicken blood was splashed all over the floor...

Behind him, Heifu had already placed his sword across Rizheng's throat, making him unable to move.

Ahead, Dongmen Leopard also trampled Tian Dian under his feet. He lifted up his clothes, revealing the armor underneath and the two halberds pinned to his waist!

Dongmen Leopard was not afraid of five people, and shouted with angry eyes:

"Who dares to come even half a step further! Nai Gong will let the blood of this bitch splash all over you!"
